mapper.select: SELECT id, task_code, agent_type, biz_type, biz_id, biz_ref, input_snapshot, output_result, alert_level, score, confidence, suggestion, matched_rules, cost_ms, model_version, status, error_msg, caller_id, caller_name, source, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_agent_prediction WHERE task_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pmis_agent_prediction SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT agent_type, alert_level, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM pmis_agent_prediction WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY agent_type, alert_level
